create_svg_visualization: create an SVG visualization of ASE atoms or pymatgen structures using AseView.make_svg
launch_interactive_gui: launch an interactive tkinter GUI to view atomic structures using AseView.make_gui
create_threejs_render: create a pythreejs 3D render of atoms or structures using AseView.make_render
add_miller_plane: add a Miller plane with custom color and opacity to the AseView visualization config
launch_gui_subprocess: launch a non-blocking GUI subprocess to view atoms by piping JSON data via stdin
